newsitem.title: MEXICO: SOCCER-HERMOSILLO HAT-TRICK HELPS MEXICO TO 6-0 WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HERMOSILLO HAT-TRICK HELPS MEXICO TO 6-0 WIN.

text.p: Veteran striker Carlos Hermosillo scored a hat-trick as Mexico thrashed Jamaica 6-0 in a World Cup qualifier on Sunday.
Jamaica, aiming to become the first West Indian island to reach the World Cup finals, were outclassed after 36-year-old midfielder Benjamin Galindo converted a tenth-minute penalty.
Hermosillo scored twice before the break, then again in the first minute of the second half to the delight of a capacity 120,000 crowd. Joaquin del Olmo and Luis Hernandez completed the rout.

Mexico, who face a tough game away to the United States next Sunday, lead the CONCACAF group with seven points from three games and look certain to qualify for their 12th World Cup next year in France.
